explanation: Orcas belong to the oceanic dolphin family, and so do pilot whales. Dolphins are toothed whales anyway, so the name killer whale is not wrong either.

claims.text: The killer whale (orca) is a member of the oceanic dolphin family, Delphinidae.
Pilot whales also belong to the oceanic dolphin family.
